titleStmt.title: Exemplo sintetico para teste de regressao

div.head: Material and methods
div.p: Tadpoles of Exemplaria ficta were collected between January and May, in temporary ponds. Thirty tadpoles at stages 31-38 were used for the description, and were kept in aquaria at 24 C until metamorphosis.

div.head: Description of the tadpole of Exemplaria ficta
div.p: External morphology. Body oval in dorsal view and globular in lateral view. Snout rounded in dorsal and lateral views. Eyes large, dorsally positioned, dorsolaterally directed. Spiracle sinistral, opening at the end of the middle third of the body.

div.head: Discussion
div.p: The tadpole of Exemplaria ficta differs from its congeners in the position of the spiracle and in snout length, as discussed above for the eyes of related forms.
